description: This file defines the Project entity class for the OrangeHRM system, utilizing Doctrine ORM annotations to map class properties to database table columns. It includes properties such as project id, customer association, name, description, deletion status, and project administrators, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Entity class representing a project in the OrangeHRM system, mapped to the 'ohrm_project' database table with properties for project details and relationships to customer and employees.

methods.name: setCustomer
methods.description: Associates a Customer object with the project.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the project is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project as deleted or active.

methods.name: getProjectAdmins
methods.description: Returns the list of project administrator Employee objects.
